notes: A buyer ISO forwarded on behalf of a colleague's client ('my colleague Sarah's buyer is looking for...'). Correct = BUYER_ISO with the buyer criteria and party captured. Watch for a CLIENT_CONVERSATION or NOISE misroute caused by the third-party framing; no address leakage.

input.subject: Anything quiet coming up in Cobble Hill? (colleague's buyer)
input.bodyText:
Hey everyone,

My colleague Sarah Levin's buyer is looking for a 2BR in Cobble Hill, up to $1.6M, prewar preferred, needs outdoor space. Anyone have something quiet coming up?

They're flexible on timing but very particular about charm and a little private outdoor area. Reach out to me and I'll loop Sarah in.

Thanks,
Marcus
